market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 in 2026 with a history of serious injuries, including a long-term ACL tear in 2023–24 that limited his play and could diminish his effectiveness. While he remains a cultural icon and has expressed interest in playing, Brazil's deep pool of young attacking talent and the typical decline of 34-year-old forwards make a WC appearance far from certain. The market's 79% implied probability overstates his chances substantially.
evidence_points: Age: Neymar turns 34 in February 2026, an age when most forwards lose pace and injury resistance.
Injury history: major ACL injury in October 2023 sidelined him for a year; recurring muscle injuries before that.
Competition: Brazil has emerging stars like Vinícius Jr., Rodrygo, Endrick, and others who may surpass him by 2026.
Club form: playing in Saudi Arabia (Al-Hilal) may not provide the level of intensity to keep him in top international shape.
Not guaranteed: selection is subject to coach's choice and fitness; a single injury could rule him out.
sources_consulted: ESPN, BBC Sport reports on Neymar's 2023 ACL injury and return
